description: Attach an existing script to a node in the edited scene (undoable). Pass script=null to detach.

dry_run.description: Preview only: validate and describe the change without applying it.

node.description: Node path relative to the edited scene's root; '.' is the root itself (e.g. 'Player/Sprite2D').

script.description: res:// path of the script, or null to detach.

name: script_attach
title: Attach script
